Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: clean static hub background plate for Project Kingdom, a painted-anime isometric RPG. Reference 1 supplies ONLY the elevated orthographic gameplay camera and blue/cream/teal material language; reference 2 supplies ONLY the charming plaza architecture and atmosphere. Generate one finished wide landscape PNG, approximately 16:9, at the largest native size available.
Camera: fixed orthographic three-quarter isometric view looking down about 35 degrees; no sky, no horizon, no lens distortion, no vanishing point. Consistent straight verticals, roofs and two walls visible, no crooked or leaning houses. This is a full continuous town map filling all edges, not a floating diorama.
Layout: a generous pedestrian plaza with a broad clear oval/circular warm-stone paved center and a subtly patterned round fountain placement socket, but NO fountain yet. Six distinct permanent buildings enclose the rear and sides: a welcoming cream community hall with clock gable at upper middle, a blue-and-ivory-awning bakery at upper left, a green-awning grocer beside it, a small bookshop at upper right, and two different cream cottages wrapping the far left and right edges. Blue slate roofs, teal shutters, chimneys, climbing vines and modest window flowerboxes. Buildings sit on one consistent ground grid. The plaza has unobstructed exits at lower-left, lower-right and between the rear buildings. Low planted flowerbeds and low garden walls may border the buildings, but the central and foreground plaza remain open and easy to navigate.
Style: original hand-painted anime background, soft gouache/watercolor materials, delicate architectural drawing, luminous cream stone, natural greens and muted blue roofs. The supplied square is the mood reference, not a location to reproduce literally. Preserve broad calm masses and believable buildings.
Lighting: neutral softly diffused noon daylight, modest cool ambient shade. Avoid strong directional cast shadows and avoid hard baked tree silhouettes: separately animated objects must be added later.
CRITICAL CLEAN PLATE: no people, cats, dogs, animals, vendors, carts, stalls, freestanding trees, lamps, benches, noticeboards, postboxes, cars, fountain, game characters, UI, text overlays, location labels, icons or watermark. All of these movable/occluding objects will be separate assets. No pixel art, photorealism or glossy 3D rendering. This is an empty reusable BACKGROUND, not a gameplay screenshot.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual transparent game sprite POSE/WALK SHEET, not a poster. The reference supplies original anime character language and isometric view only; do not reproduce its environment, UI or other characters.
Subject: one original bipedal orange tabby CAT adventurer with cream muzzle, amber eyes, red neckerchief, cream shirt, simple brown leather vest, olive trousers, small brown satchel and boots. A modest short sword stays lowered in the right paw; no giant shield hiding the body. Same outfit, anatomy, head size, equipment and scale in all frames, appealing clean anime outlines with soft flat cel shading, around 3.5 heads tall. No pixel art or glossy CGI.
OUTPUT: exactly twelve complete isolated full-body character poses in a precise FOUR COLUMN by THREE ROW regular grid on genuinely transparent alpha, wide landscape canvas. No drawn grid, no labels, no text, no floor, no scenery, no cast shadows. All cells equal size with generous transparent gutters. Never crop ears, tails, weapons or feet, and never let one pose touch another cell.
COLUMN DIRECTIONS remain constant in every row: column 1 faces southeast (down-right, front three-quarter); column 2 southwest (down-left, front three-quarter); column 3 northeast (up-right, rear three-quarter); column 4 northwest (up-left, rear three-quarter). An elevated camera looking down about 35 degrees sees the top of the head and shoulders. The back views must genuinely show the back, not another front view.
ROW 1: standing idle. ROW 2: walking contact pose A, left leg forward and right leg back with a gentle opposite arm swing. ROW 3: complementary walking contact pose B, right leg forward and left leg back. These are alternate walk phases, not different character designs.
REGISTRATION: equal apparent character height and foot baseline in all twelve cells, body centered within each cell; keep visible padding. Neutral diffuse illumination, no strong baked sunny highlights. Intended for small readable isometric RPG characters and later independent day/night tinting. Keep the exact face, proportions, clothing and tail identity consistent. Alpha background must be empty, not white or a painted checkerboard.
